meaning: to rely on, to go by; on the basis of

senses.en: to rely on, to go by; on the basis of

note: 凭什么 = "on what grounds?"; 凭票 = with a ticket.

examples.zh: 你凭什么不让我进去？
examples.en: On what grounds won't you let me in?

examples.zh: 进门请凭票，没有票不能进。
examples.en: Entry is by ticket only; without one you can't go in.

examples.zh: 他凭自己的努力考上了大学。
examples.en: He got into university through his own effort.

meaning: to master, to have a grasp of; to control

senses.en: to master, to have a grasp of; to control

examples.zh: 他已经掌握了开车的方法。
examples.en: He has already mastered how to drive.

examples.zh: 想掌握一门语言，要多说多练。
examples.en: To master a language, you must speak and practice a lot.

examples.zh: 这件事我掌握的情况不多。
examples.en: I don't have much information about this matter.

meaning: robot

senses.en: robot

examples.zh: 这家餐厅有机器人送菜。
examples.en: This restaurant has a robot that serves the dishes.

examples.zh: 我儿子最喜欢的礼物是机器人。
examples.en: My son's favorite gift is a robot.

examples.zh: 以后机器人会做更多家务。
examples.en: In the future robots will do more housework.

meaning: romantic

senses.en: romantic

examples.zh: 他们在海边过了一个浪漫的晚上。
examples.en: They spent a romantic evening by the sea.

examples.zh: 你男朋友真浪漫！
examples.en: Your boyfriend is so romantic!

examples.zh: 我不太懂浪漫，只会做饭。
examples.en: I don't really get romance; I can only cook.

meaning: to appreciate, to enjoy; to admire

senses.en: to appreciate, to enjoy; to admire

examples.zh: 我很欣赏你的工作态度。
examples.en: I really admire your attitude toward work.

examples.zh: 周末我想去欣赏一场音乐会。
examples.en: This weekend I'd like to go enjoy a concert.

examples.zh: 她喜欢一个人安静地欣赏风景。
examples.en: She likes quietly enjoying the scenery on her own.

meaning: hard to, difficult to (+ verb)

senses.en: hard to, difficult to (+ verb)

note: Written/formal; spoken: 很难 or 不容易.

examples.zh: 这件事难以相信。
examples.en: This is hard to believe.

examples.zh: 他的想法让人难以理解。
examples.en: His way of thinking is hard to understand.

examples.zh: 这么多菜，我一个人难以吃完。
examples.en: With so many dishes, I can hardly finish them alone.

meaning: to piece together; to go all out

senses.en: to piece together; to go all out

note: 拼车 = carpool; 拼命 = go all out.

examples.zh: 弟弟正在拼玩具。
examples.en: My younger brother is putting a toy together.

examples.zh: 我们拼车去机场吧，能省钱。
examples.en: Let's carpool to the airport; it saves money.

examples.zh: 为了家庭，他每天都在拼。
examples.en: For his family he gives it his all every day.

meaning: energy (physical or figurative)

senses.en: energy (physical or figurative)

examples.zh: 早饭能给身体提供能量。
examples.en: Breakfast gives the body energy.

examples.zh: 我今天一点能量都没有。
examples.en: I have no energy at all today.

examples.zh: 太阳给地球带来很多能量。
examples.en: The sun brings the Earth a lot of energy.

meaning: to be familiar with; familiar

senses.en: to be familiar with; familiar

examples.zh: 这个城市我很熟悉。
examples.en: I know this city very well.

examples.zh: 我刚来，还不熟悉这里的环境。
examples.en: I just arrived and am not yet familiar with the surroundings.

examples.zh: 你熟悉这个软件吗？
examples.en: Are you familiar with this software?

meaning: slippery; to slip, to slide

senses.en: slippery; to slip, to slide

examples.zh: 地很滑，走路要小心。
examples.en: The floor is slippery; walk carefully.

examples.zh: 他在冰上滑了一下，差点摔了。
examples.en: He slipped on the ice and almost fell.

examples.zh: 这个人太滑了，别信他的话。
examples.en: That guy is too slippery; don't trust what he says.

meaning: to recognize; to admit

senses.en: to recognize; to admit

note: 认错 = admit a mistake; 认不出 = can't recognize.

examples.zh: 对不起，我认错人了。
examples.en: Sorry, I mistook you for someone else.

examples.zh: 我认不出他了，他变了很多。
examples.en: I couldn't recognize him; he has changed a lot.

examples.zh: 他做错了事，却不想认。
examples.en: He did something wrong but won't admit it.

meaning: to bear, to endure

senses.en: to bear, to endure

examples.zh: 我没办法忍受邻居半夜唱歌。
examples.en: I can't stand my neighbor singing in the middle of the night.

examples.zh: 他一直忍受着牙疼，没去医院。
examples.en: He kept putting up with the toothache and didn't go to the hospital.

examples.zh: 这么热的天，真让人难以忍受。
examples.en: On a day this hot, it's really hard to bear.

meaning: to insert, to stick in; to cut in

senses.en: to insert, to stick in; to cut in

examples.zh: 请把手机插到这里充电。
examples.en: Please plug your phone in here to charge.

examples.zh: 大家在说话，我想插一句。
examples.en: Everyone is talking; I'd like to chip in a word.

examples.zh: 他把花插在瓶子里。
examples.en: He put the flowers in the vase.

meaning: to transport, to carry by vehicle

senses.en: to transport, to carry by vehicle

note: Also "luck" in 运气, 好运.

examples.zh: 这些货明天会运到上海。
examples.en: These goods will be shipped to Shanghai tomorrow.

examples.zh: 我要把书运回国。
examples.en: I want to ship my books back to my home country.

examples.zh: 这辆车是用来运水果的。
examples.en: This truck is used to carry fruit.

meaning: to recall; memory

senses.en: to recall; memory

examples.zh: 这张照片让我想起很多回忆。
examples.en: This photo brings back a lot of memories.

examples.zh: 他在回忆小时候的事。
examples.en: He is recalling things from his childhood.

examples.zh: 那是一段美好的回忆。
examples.en: That is a beautiful memory.

meaning: to get started doing; to hit someone

senses.en: to get started doing; to hit someone

note: 别动手 = "no hitting"; 动手做 = do it yourself.

examples.zh: 咱们别光说，快动手吧。
examples.en: Let's stop talking and get to work.

examples.zh: 他们吵起来了，千万别动手。
examples.en: They started arguing; whatever you do, don't let it turn physical.

examples.zh: 想学会做饭，就要自己动手。
examples.en: If you want to learn to cook, you have to do it yourself.

meaning: to clean up, to sort out and clear

senses.en: to clean up, to sort out and clear

examples.zh: 周末我要清理房间。
examples.en: I'm going to clean up my room this weekend.

examples.zh: 手机里的照片太多，该清理了。
examples.en: There are too many photos on my phone; time to clear them out.

examples.zh: 请把桌子上的东西清理干净。
examples.en: Please clear everything off the table.

meaning: to be present, to be on the spot

senses.en: to be present, to be on the spot

examples.zh: 出事时，你在场吗？
examples.en: Were you there when it happened?

examples.zh: 当时在场的人都看到了。
examples.en: Everyone who was there at the time saw it.

examples.zh: 老板不在场，我们没办法做决定。
examples.en: The boss isn't here, so we can't make a decision.

meaning: ear

senses.en: ear

examples.zh: 我的耳朵有点疼，想去看医生。
examples.en: My ear hurts a bit and I want to see a doctor.

examples.zh: 奶奶的耳朵不太好，请大声说。
examples.en: Grandma's hearing isn't great, so please speak loudly.

examples.zh: 我的耳朵里有水，听不见。
examples.en: I have water in my ear and can't hear.

meaning: in town, in the city (as opposed to the countryside)

senses.en: in town, in the city (as opposed to the countryside)

examples.zh: 我周末常去城里逛街。
examples.en: I often go shopping in town at weekends.

examples.zh: 他家在农村，工作在城里。
examples.en: His home is in the countryside and his work is in town.

examples.zh: 城里的房子比农村贵。
examples.en: Houses in the city cost more than in the countryside.
